g.text: Code level — parallel upload via concatenation
Every referenced upload must exist and be partial.
The final's length is the sum of the partials.
If a partial is still incomplete the final is
stop at the first partial that is
re-read under the lock: a concurrent
HEAD may already have finalized it
discardUpload(p_i) for each, under the locks still held
Later, if the final was created unfinished
the same lock dance; merges now
if the partials have since completed
